purpose: Fresh-context outcome QA only; this is not code review.

criteria.text: Projects header has compact filter/selection controls and all seven visibly named presets.
Filtering composes with host search and preserves hierarchy and working/unread styling.
Selection checkboxes protect current, working, waiting, unread, and pinned families with explanations.
Selection count, Select all, Clear, Delete, and Cancel behave predictably.
Permanent-delete confirmation shows roots, children, total, titles, and a separate confirm; cancel mutates nothing.
Short-lived token confirmation revalidates and reports deleted/skipped/failed partial outcomes.
Each project + opens native New Thread with that project/workspace selected and prompt focused, including compact drawer behavior.
Controls are accessible and preserve existing navigation, shortcuts, splits, menus, parking, and collapse behavior.
Pure automated coverage and real wide/compact browser screenshots exist.

liveObservations: Unread preset reduced the view to the two unread bb-plugins families while preserving their status labels.
Selection mode exposed disabled checkboxes labelled with the Unread protection reason.
Quiet selection preview showed one root, zero children, total one, the root title, Cancel, and Delete permanently.
Cancel closed the dialog, kept the selected checkbox, and left the thread present; confirm was not invoked.
Naranja + selected Naranja and focused the prompt on wide layout.
bb-plugins + on 390px layout closed the drawer, selected bb-plugins, showed Local/branch workspace controls, and focused the prompt.
The real protected preview RPC returned token null and did not invoke deletion.
Exact-tree regressions prove that adding or removing a quiet descendant after preview yields scope-changed and performs no deletion.
Exact-tree selection regression proves a selected family remains visible after becoming unread outside the Quiet preset; the UI renders per-id skipped/failed outcomes.
safety: No real thread was deleted during browser QA.
